sections.label: Infiltration
sections.intent: Stealthy entry, sparse textures, low pulse and sparse percussion, motif introduced.

sections.label: Near Miss
sections.intent: Negative space, tension through silence, occasional heartbeats and impacts.

sections.label: Decision
sections.intent: Building urgency, motif returns varied, stop-start patterns, rising filtered noise.

sections.label: Sprint
sections.intent: Dense rhythmic drive, constant hi-hats, octave bass pulse, impacts every two bars.

sections.label: Cut
sections.intent: Hard editorial ending with final impact, motif note, and abrupt stop.

tracks.name: Sub Pulse
tracks.instrument_hint: sine-like sub bass with slow attack

tracks.name: Muted Percussion
tracks.instrument_hint: filtered electronic drums, woodblock-like, short decay

tracks.name: High Tick
tracks.instrument_hint: short metallic tick or hi-hat, precise

tracks.name: Dark Harmony
tracks.instrument_hint: dark pad or low strings, slow attack

tracks.name: Motif
tracks.instrument_hint: plucked synth or processed piano, clear but dark

tracks.name: Impact Layer
tracks.instrument_hint: cinematic impacts, low booms, reversed cymbal

tracks.name: Texture
tracks.instrument_hint: airy noise, granular, reversed shimmer, not tonal
